rows.grounds: Numeral indicating the quantity eighty-four, qualifying the following thousands.
Denotes a large number in the thousands, located in the plural.
Compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device), indicating the loci of birth.
Past passive participle describing beings subjected to suffering or affliction.

items.question: What is the extent of torment experienced within the multitude of womb-mechanisms?
premises: The scope is specified as eighty-four thousands.
These thousands are womb-mechanisms serving as loci of existence.
Beings within these womb-mechanisms are tormented.
items.inference: Beings undergo torment across the vast expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
